subject: pol-dym
title: POL.DYM.------WO.EXP.PRI.
description: Chart on book p. 365 (R(AS)CM(II)-9). POL-DYM (political dynamics) is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of"; WO-EXP-PRI (world expansion principle) is the partner. From the subject: TRS (transition) and STF (source transfer). From TRS: SOC-RT-DY (social reality dynamics). From STF: LG-EXT (logical extension) and PRI-INFO (principle information). From SOC-RT-DY: ACC-FT (accelerated functionalism). From PRI-INFO: SPT-DYM (spiritual dynamics).
